__comment_overview: This file tells Vercel how to build and route the monorepo.
It defines two builds (backend + frontend) and routing rules.
1. Any request to /api/* is handled by the Node.js backend function.
Vercel wraps backend/index.js as a serverless function.
2. Everything else (/, /route, assets, etc.) is served from
the compiled React frontend static files.

builds.__comment: Backend: Vercel runs index.js as a Node.js serverless function
Frontend: Vercel builds the React app with 'npm run build' (Vite) and serves the dist/ folder as static files

routes.__comment: Rule 1: API requests go to the backend serverless function
Rule 2: Everything else goes to the React frontend build output
